row.evidence: Render's pricing page lists SAML SSO & SCIM among the Scale features ($499/month + compute); Pro ($25/month + compute) does not include them.
row.notes: Flat workspace pricing plus compute, so per-user fields stay null; prices shown per month (no annual option seen). SCIM jumps from the $25/mo Pro team plan to the $499/mo Scale plan, which also adds SAML SSO and organizations. SCIM base URL https://sso.render.com/scim/v2/ with a bearer token; deprovisioned members are logged out immediately and their API keys invalidated. JIT on SAML login for all SAML orgs. REST API (all plans) lists members, changes roles and removes members, but cannot invite.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Single team member only, so not a team plan.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat workspace fee plus usage; unlimited seats. Workspace audit logs.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Adds organizations, SAML SSO & SCIM, advanced RBAC roles and org audit logs.

auth.token_source: Org Settings > Security > SCIM Provisioning > + Create (Org Owner)

deprovision.data_retained: Services created by the member remain active; the member's API keys are invalidated.
deprovision.notes: Docs say deprovisioned members are logged out and cannot log back in; whether the user is removed from the org or kept in a disabled state is not stated, so 'remove_from_org' is the closest reading.

limitations.text: Each Render organization can connect only one IdP for SSO (and so SCIM).
Downgrading from Scale deletes the org and its SSO and SCIM configuration.

scim.notes: SCIM is configured on the SAML application created for Render after SSO is set up; SCIM manages org members (standard members with IdP-managed email). Docs give no attribute, endpoint or group detail.

capabilities.notes: create/invite false by absence from the API reference index (llms.txt); invites are done in the dashboard.

audit_log_api.notes: Workspace audit logs from Pro; organization audit logs from Scale.

rate_limits.text: All other GET: 400/minute; all other POST/PATCH/DELETE: 30/minute (per user).

user_api.notes: The public REST API can list workspace members, change a member's role and remove a member; it has no endpoint to invite or create members. API keys are per user and created in Account Settings; no plan gate is stated for the API.

okta.notes: Render's guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM enabled in the IdP; no catalogue app was found or cited.

entra.notes: Render's guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM enabled in the IdP; no catalogue app was found or cited.
